definitions.meaning: to guide someone or point them along the right route
going without deviation, as a non-stop route or a frank answer

clue.text: Picture-maker portraying sport in colour following 25's work

explanation.definitionFit: Albrecht Dürer was the great German Renaissance painter and engraver, a maker of pictures.

indicators.note: something happening unexpectedly comes out in a surprising form, so the next word's letters are rearranged
